name: MOONBASE
what: Text adventure: escape the damaged moon base. Two-word commands, 10 rooms.

name: Lunar Lander
what: Land on the pad before the fuel runs out. Easy and Hard. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Pong
what: You on the right against the computer. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Racer
what: Keep the car on a scrolling, winding road. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Invaders
what: Two rows of six invaders and an arrow-key gun. VT100.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
what: You are X against a simple AI.

name: Maze
what: VM1 builds a maze, VM2 solves it. Two programs, one file. VT100.

name: Lite-Writer 2
what: Full-screen word processor: word wrap, find, cut/paste, 4 save slots. VT100.

name: ELIZA
what: The classic 1966 chatbot psychotherapist.

name: Banner
what: Prints what you type as big block letters.

name: GETSTR
what: The $C2 line-input opcode: read a line, print it back.

name: String Store
what: Keep three typed lines in slots and print them back.

name: Morse Sender v17
what: Type text; it is sent as Morse code on the Q output.

name: Morse Receiver v10
what: Key Morse on the Input switch; it learns your hand and prints the text.
note: simulator-verified, not yet run on hardware

name: Simple-Calc-5
what: 5-digit calculator, all in STELLAR bytecode.

name: Simple-Calc-8
what: 8-digit calculator, math in native 1802 via RUNMC.

name: Prime-Gen v07
what: Primes in a range you choose, using the native OUTDEC print.

name: Prime-Gen v05
what: Primes by odd-only trial division.

name: Prime-Gen v04
what: An earlier prime generator (multiply-back divide test).

name: Mandelbrot
what: The Mandelbrot set in ASCII.

name: Game of Life
what: Conway's Life on a 40x20 grid: a blinker and a glider. VT100.

name: Sort visualiser
what: Watch a bubble sort as VT100 bars.

name: Starfield
what: Stars streaming outward; you pick how many. VT100.

name: Bouncing Ball
what: Two balls bouncing around the screen and off each other. VT100.

name: Starship
what: The COSMAC ELF starship logo in ASCII.

name: Front panel
what: Lights the Q lamp and counts $00-$1F on the hex display.

name: Mandelbrot x 4
what: Four VMs draw a quarter of the Mandelbrot set each. One file.

name: Maze Race
what: VM1 builds a maze; VM2 and VM3 race it, right hand against left. One file.

name: Life Race
what: Game of Life in bytecode against native 1802, side by side. One file.

name: Race condition (VM1)
what: Two VMs share a counter: without a lock, counts go missing. Load this file first.

name: Race condition (VM2)
what: The second worker for the race-condition demo. Load after VM1.

name: FW-Checksum V0061.34
what: Checks the firmware after loading: prints 15 checksums to compare with the list in the file.
